description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EducationDao within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It tests CRUD operations and utility methods related to Education entities, including adding, editing, retrieving by ID or name, listing, deleting, and validation of education names.

classes.name: EducationDaoTest
classes.description: Test class for EducationDao, contains multiple test methods to verify educator data manipulation functions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by instantiating EducationDao and populating test data from fixture file.

methods.name: testAddEducation
methods.description: Tests adding a new Education entity and verifying it was saved correctly.

methods.name: testEditEducation
methods.description: Tests editing an existing Education entity and verifying updates.

methods.name: testGetEducationById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of Education entity by ID.

methods.name: testGetEducationList
methods.description: Tests listing Education entities with filtering.

methods.name: testDeleteEducations
methods.description: Tests bulk deletion of Education entities.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests deletion attempt on non-existing Education entities and expects zero deletions.

methods.name: testIsExistingEducationName
methods.description: Tests validation of existing education names, accounting for case and whitespace.

methods.name: testGetEducationByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of Education by name with various case and whitespace variations.
